title: Hiking Safety Guide Printable PDF, Trail Safety Tips, Hypothermia Heat Signs, Getting Lost, Emergency Reference Card, Beginner Hiker Gift
description:
Ten chapters on what actually goes wrong on trails, and what to do about it. Not survival theatrics: the ordinary failures that cause real trouble on ordinary days out.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- How Days Go Wrong: the chain of small decisions behind most incidents
- Getting Lost: prevention, and what to do when you realise
- Weather Turning
- Cold and Hypothermia: the signs, including the ones people miss
- Heat and Dehydration
- Injuries on the Trail
- Running Out of Daylight: a turnaround time that holds
- Wildlife
- Calling for Help: what to say, and saving battery
- Emergency Reference: one page to print or screenshot

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions, print-ready
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
General information for recreational hikers. Not a substitute for first-aid training or emergency services. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
